cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Social Media Content Creator role at your agency. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience in content creation and social media management, I am confident in my ability to create engaging content and grow brand presence for your clients.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my copywriting skills by writing keyword-targeted blog content and managing on-page SEO for client websites. This experience has taught me how to craft content that resonates with audiences and drives engagement. I am also comfortable with content management systems and have built and maintained websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme, ensuring that all content is visually appealing and aligned with brand guidelines.

One of my proudest projects is mirook.com, a website I designed and built for a Belgian youth chess champion. I not only handled the technical aspects but also integrated social media channels (Instagram and Facebook) to create a cohesive online presence. I developed content that highlighted the champion's achievements and engaged followers, demonstrating my ability to manage social media accounts and create compelling posts.

I am well-versed in major social platforms and understand the importance of monitoring trends and engagement metrics. I have used tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance and adjust strategies accordingly. My attention to detail and creative thinking enable me to produce high-quality content that stands out.

I am excited about the opportunity to work with a young and dynamic team, and I am eager to pursue social media certification and contribute to your clients' success. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your agency.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
